account.emailHint: Contact your administrator to change your login email.

account.devicesIntro: A device password lets a calendar, contact or file program reach your apps as you, when it only asks for a username and a password. Make one for each device, for what it needs, and revoke it when the device is gone. It stops working when you change your password, and after 30 days without use.
account.devicesNoWays: No calendar, contact or file program can reach this workspace's apps yet. An administrator approves that per app.
account.devicesUnavailable: Device passwords are not available right now.
account.devicesWaysHint: Choose only what the program on this device needs.
account.devicesSignInAgain: For your safety, a device password is made only within ten minutes of signing in. Sign in again, then come back here.
account.devicesMadeOnce: Enter these in the program now. The password is shown only this once.
account.devicesRevokeConfirm: Revoke the device password for {{name}}? The program on that device stops syncing.
account.connectionsIntro: Your sign-ins at services outside this workspace, such as a recorder or a mail service. The agents you run call these services as you, and only for what you start or schedule. What a service hands back stays with the workspace, never with an agent. Disconnect a service to end it.
account.connectionsDeclined: The service's sign-in was declined, so nothing was connected.
account.connectionsFailed: The sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
account.connectionsNone: No app in this workspace calls a service outside it.
account.connectionsUnavailable: Connections are not available right now.
